dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No maa wo te?
dialogue.translation: Which thing will you choose?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Mepɛ no wɔ menu no so, ne sɛ yɛnni nni?
dialogue.translation: I like this thing on the menu, and if we eat it?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yɛ, nso ɛyɛ den?
dialogue.translation: Yes, also what is it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ɛyɛ fufu ne nkatenkwan.
dialogue.translation: It is fufu and soup.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ɛma me fa no kɔ wo bank.
dialogue.translation: Let me do it at your bank.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ɔte sɛ ɔbɛfa dɛn?
dialogue.translation: What exactly will he/she do?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mepɛ sɛ mafa mu no kɔ nka account.
dialogue.translation: I want to deposit the money into my account.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yiw, ma ɔfa no.
dialogue.translation: Okay, let him/her do it.
